The KGNS article reports that more than 250 teachers who lacked proper certifications were employed in classrooms within the Webb and Zapata school districts during the previous academic year. This number highlights a significant gap between teaching staff credentials and state certification requirements for those districts. The report underscores concerns about instructional quality and regulatory compliance.
